'''Binn Ibes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Binn Ibes was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and understand the Path of the Jedi by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. A contemporary of famed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Ibes gained the title of Master as well, at which time he selected the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Reeft]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Reeft would go on to complete his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], completing his training under Ibes and ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="TCT" />
